title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Why This Role Is Different**
Most engineers spend their careers on a single product, working through someone else's backlog. At Techdome, you'll build across four live, revenue-generating products: an AI-driven hiring platform, a healthcare management portal, a stock trading and investment app, and fintech payments infrastructure. We're a lean team, so there's no layer of process between you and the people using what you build.
  
  
You'll work side by side with Product and Design, take ownership of your features from first idea to production, and gain experience in domains that many engineers spend years trying to get into.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Taking features from concept to launch: scoping, system design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration.
* Building fast, responsive user interfaces with React.js, and secure, scalable services with Node.js and Express.js.
* Designing REST APIs, backend services, and third-party integrations, with authentication and authorization done right (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC).
* Working with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL for data modeling and querying, and using Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend.
* Moving across all four product lines, covering payment flows, healthcare workflows, trading features, and AI-powered recruitment tools, rather than being confined to one area.
* Contributing to architecture discussions, sprint planning, code reviews, and releases.
* Diagnosing production issues, tuning performance, and supporting your features after they ship.
* Making AI-assisted development (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) part of your everyday workflow, not an occasional experiment.

**What You Should Have**

* 1.5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, or Product Engineer.
* Strong skills in React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Working knowledge of Next.js and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* A solid understanding of REST API design, Git workflows, Agile/SDLC practices, and secure coding.
* Practical experience in debugging, deployments, and production support.

**Nice to Have**

* Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* CI/CD pipelines and microservices architecture.
* Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ for caching, queuing, or real-time data.
* Strong system design skills and a history of performance optimization.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and application security awareness.
* Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, LangChain, AI agents, prompt engineering, MCP servers, or vector databases.

**Life at Techdome**
We're a product company, not a services shop or a headcount factory, building across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, and Enterprise Automation. We look for engineers who want real ownership, and we give them the autonomy and trust to build things that matter.

title: The Core Engineering - KYC Model Eng - Vice President - Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
**About Compliance Engineering**
The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm.
  
  
Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on
**Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer**
to join our technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications.
  
  
As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence—actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions.
  
  
Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture
* System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards.
* Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our frontend and backend tech stack.
* Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems.
* Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Hands-on Engineering
* Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, React or Angular, and Python.
* Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
* ETL Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows using Spring Batch. This includes configuring components for complex data transformations and high-volume ingestion.
* API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability.
* Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle) and non-relational (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
* AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes.
* Team Mentorship & Collaboration
* Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline.
* Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
**Education & Experience**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.

**Technical Skills**

* Backend Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services.
* Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Spring Boot and Spring Batch. Must understand job partitioning, multi-threaded steps, and fault-tolerance policies (skip/retry).
* Frontend Expertise: Strong front-end development experience using React or Angular to build responsive, user-focused web applications.
* Python Development: Solid Python development experience for automation, services, scripting, analytics workflows, or platform enablement.
* AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features.
* Architecture & Design: Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns.
* Messaging & Streaming: Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and messaging-based integrations using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time data triggers.
* SQL Mastery: Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL technologies.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit to our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

This role will provide people leadership and technical direction for full stack engineering teams responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and user-centric applications. title: Manager Technology | Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: SW Engineer -- Workato Integrations
description:
**Overview**
**ABOUT JAGGAER**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education.
  
  
We're looking for a mid-level Software Engineer (3–4 years) with deep Workato expertise to design, build, and operate integrations that serve two audiences simultaneously: internal enterprise teams (Finance, Sales, HR, Customer Success) and external JAGGAER customers who rely on standard integrations with ERP, CRM, and procurement systems.
  
  
This is not a "build recipes and hand off" role. You'll own integrations end-to-end — from scoping and design through deployment, monitoring, and long-term maintenance — while contributing to the architectural standards that govern how integrations are built across the organization.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Integration Design & Development**

* Design reusable, modular Workato recipes following integration best practices — built for scale, not just the immediate use case
* Build event-driven and scheduled integrations using webhooks, polling, and API triggers
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, dead-letter patterns, and exception notifications
* Configure authentication flows including OAuth 2.0, API Key, Basic Auth, and JWT
* Work with SOAP and REST APIs — including WSDL parsing, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, pagination, rate limiting, and throttling
* Create and maintain reusable lookup tables, callable recipes, and centralized utility recipes
* Leverage the Workato API Platform, custom connectors, and advanced formula language / Ruby scripting for complex transformation needs

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with business analysts, product managers, and engineers across Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Engineering, and Finance to gather and refine requirements
* Translate ambiguous business needs into well-scoped technical solutions — own the gap between a business problem and a working integration
* Engage directly with external customer teams during integration scoping, QA, and go-live support for standard product integrations
* Communicate integration design decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

**Operations, Quality & Architecture**

* Troubleshoot and optimize existing Workato workflows — proactively identify performance bottlenecks and failure modes before they affect customers
* Maintain comprehensive documentation: recipe logic, data flow diagrams, error handling runbooks, and integration catalogs
* Stay current with Workato platform releases, new connectors, and evolving iPaaS best practices — bring recommendations proactively
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of JAGGAER's integration architecture and the standards that govern how integrations are built, versioned, and maintained
* Collaborate with the Agentic AI engineering team on opportunities to automate and orchestrate workflows using JAI Assist and AgentOS

**Position Requirements**

* 3–4 years of hands-on experience developing and maintaining Workato integrations in a production environment
* Strong command of REST and SOAP APIs — including WSDL, OpenAPI/Swagger, pagination, rate limiting, and OAuth 2.0 / JWT authentication
* Proficiency in JSON, XML, XPath, and data transformation; solid working knowledge of Workato formula language

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Technical Team Lead – Java**
with strong hands-on backend development experience, proven technical leadership capabilities, and the ability to lead and manage a full engineering team end to end.

The ideal candidate will come from a
**Fintech, Forex, Trading, or high-performance systems environment**
, with strong experience in
**Java, microservices architecture, API development, backend integrations, low-latency systems, and cloud-based delivery**
.

This is a critical leadership role within the engineering organization. The person will be responsible not only for hands-on technical guidance, but also for ensuring the team is properly structured, aligned, productive, and delivering according to business priorities. The role requires someone who can stay fully on top of team activities, break down work, assign responsibilities, remove blockers, challenge estimates, monitor progress, and ensure delivery commitments are met.

The Technical Team Lead will act as the main point of reference for the team from a technical and delivery perspective, working closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Mobile, Trading, Risk, and other business stakeholders.

The person should be able to lead with minimal supervision, take full ownership of the team’s technical direction, and ensure engineering standards, delivery quality, and operational reliability are consistently maintained.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Ownership**

* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Java backend developers.
* Take ownership of the team’s day-to-day execution, priorities, delivery progress, and technical output.
* Ensure all team members have clear responsibilities, priorities, and expected deliverables.
* Break down technical work into clear tasks and assign them effectively across the team.
* Monitor team progress closely and proactively identify delays, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Act as the first escalation point for the team and help unblock issues quickly.
* Ensure the team is working efficiently, with clear communication and accountability.
* Support onboarding, knowledge sharing, coaching, and continuous development of team members.
* Promote ownership, collaboration, technical discipline, and a delivery-focused mindset within the team.

**2. Technical Leadership**

* Provide strong technical direction across backend systems, integrations, and trading-related services.
* Lead technical design discussions and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure engineering standards, best practices, and clean coding principles are followed.
* Challenge technical decisions where needed and ensure the team follows the correct architecture and implementation approach.
* Support developers with complex technical issues and ensure the right solutions are implemented.
* Drive technical documentation, implementation plans, and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Ensure technical decisions are clearly communicated to Product, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.

**3. Backend Architecture & Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java, preferably Java 17+.
* Build and enhance microservices, REST APIs, event-driven services, and backend modules for trading workflows.
* Work on trading platform integrations, liquidity management systems, price feeds, risk engines, execution services, and internal backend tools.
* Apply modern architecture practices such as domain-driven design, CQRS, event-driven architecture, and event sourcing where relevant.
* Work with Vaadin framework for internal UI and console development where required.
* Understand and contribute to mixed Java/Kotlin environments where applicable.
* Collaborate with mobile teams and understand API integration requirements for iOS Swift and Android/Kotlin applications.
* Ensure backend services are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with platform requirements.

**4. System Performance, Stability & Reliability**

* Build and maintain low-latency, high-availability backend components.
* Optimize system performance through concurrency tuning, JVM tuning, GC optimization, and efficient service design.
* Support performance testing, load testing, and production-readiness activities.
* Lead or support incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensure production issues are properly analyzed, documented, and followed up with preventive actions.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Cloud, QA, and monitoring teams to improve system reliability.
* Promote a strong engineering culture around stability, observability, and operational excellence.

**5. Delivery & Project Ownership**

* Drive technical delivery across sprint planning, task breakdown, execution, and release readiness.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Product Managers to understand requirements, clarify scope, and define realistic delivery timelines.
* Challenge unclear requirements, incomplete analysis, or unrealistic timelines where needed.
* Ensure technical dependencies, risks, and blockers are identified early and communicated clearly.
* Track delivery progress and make sure the team is moving according to agreed priorities.
* Ensure releases are delivered with the required quality, documentation, testing support, and technical sign-off.
* Maintain clear communication with Product, QA, DevOps, and management regarding status, risks, and delivery expectations.
* Take ownership of delivery outcomes, not only technical implementation.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Work closely with QA and QA Automation teams to support testing, integration testing, regression testing, and load testing.
* Collaborate with DevOps and Cloud teams on deployments, CI/CD pipelines, environments, monitoring, and infrastructure needs.
* Coordinate with Mobile teams to ensure backend APIs and services meet mobile application requirements.
* Work with Trading, Risk, Dealing, Compliance, and Operations teams where business or system knowledge is required.
* Ensure technical communication between teams is clear, structured, and action-oriented.

**7. Engineering Standards & Process Improvement**

* Enforce coding standards, code review practices, documentation, and technical governance.
* Improve development processes, estimation accuracy, release readiness, and operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues within the team and propose practical improvements.
* Support the adoption of automation, AI tools, and engineering productivity improvements.
* Encourage the team to use modern tools and practices to increase speed, quality, and maintainability.
* Ensure the team follows agreed engineering, security, and release processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of backend engineering experience, with strong hands-on Java development.
* Strong experience with Java 17+ and modern backend development practices.
* Proven experience (2+ years) of leading a technical team (7+ members) as a team or technical lead.
* Experience managing team delivery, task breakdown, estimation, technical planning, and execution.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend integrations.
* Experience with event-driven systems, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Strong understanding of system performance, scalability, reliability, and production support.
* Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience working with DevOps teams on CI/CD, deployments, and environment management.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead with ownership, accountability, and minimal supervision.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions under pressure.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Forex, CFD, Fintech, Trading, Banking, or financial systems.
* Experience with trading platform integrations, liquidity providers, price feeds, execution systems, or risk engines.
* Knowledge of FIX Protocol and FIX Market Data.
* Experience with price feed aggregation engines.
* Experience with Vaadin framework.
* Knowledge of Kotlin and mixed Java/Kotlin environments.
* Understanding of mobile trading app architecture and backend API requirements for Swift/Kotlin applications.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or similar.
* Exposure to financial regulations such as FSA, DFSA, CySEC, FCA, ASIC, or similar.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or cloud-native architecture.
* Experience using AI tools to improve development productivity, code quality, documentation, and delivery efficiency.

Serve as a senior business analyst driving complex business transformation initiatives within a global organization translating strategic goals into actionable requirements while collaborating closely with cross functional teams. Utilize strong English speaking skills to facilitate clear communication workshops and stakeholder alignment in a work from office day shift environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive discovery sessions with business stakeholders to understand transformation objectives operational constraints and desired outcomes ensuring all perspectives are captured in clear and structured formats.
* Drive end to end analysis of existing business processes by mapping workflows documenting pain points and identifying opportunities for simplification and value creation across functions.
* Develop detailed business requirements user stories and acceptance criteria that precisely articulate the needs of business teams and are readily consumable by technology delivery partners.
* Coordinate with product owners architects and delivery teams to refine requirements manage scope and ensure that proposed solutions align with strategic business transformation goals.
* Facilitate workshops presentations and review meetings using fluent spoken English to align diverse stakeholder groups and to resolve ambiguities before solution design and build.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to validate business cases estimate benefits and track value realization from transformation initiatives over the project lifecycle.
* Create clear and concise documentation including process maps operating models and impact assessments that support decision making by senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Collaborate with change management and training teams to ensure that process changes new capabilities and policy updates are communicated effectively to impacted users.
* Support testing activities by clarifying business intent reviewing test scenarios and validating that delivered solutions meet agreed requirements and provide measurable business value.
* Partner with finance and portfolio teams to monitor progress against transformation roadmaps highlighting risks dependencies and issues that could impact timelines or benefits.
* Apply knowledge of high technology industry trends where relevant to benchmark practices propose innovative improvements and ensure that transformation initiatives remain competitive and future ready.
* Champion continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned refining analysis methods and promoting reusable frameworks that accelerate future transformation projects.
* Coordinate with global and cross functional partners in a work from office environment to maintain consistent communication rapid feedback cycles and timely resolution of open points.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate eight to ten years of progressive experience as a business analyst or similar role focused on complex business transformation programs in large organizations.
* Exhibit strong spoken and written English communication skills that enable effective facilitation of meetings clear documentation and confident engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Show proven ability to gather analyze and document business requirements using structured techniques such as process mapping use cases and user story creation.
* Display hands on experience working within technology driven environments ideally in or adjacent to high technology domains with familiarity in digital products and modern platforms.
* Illustrate experience collaborating closely with cross functional teams including technology operations finance and change management to deliver integrated transformation outcomes.
* Highlight a track record of supporting or leading user acceptance testing including validation of solutions against business requirements and coordination of defect resolution.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear solution options and well reasoned recommendations.
* Show comfort working fully from office in a day shift schedule while maintaining flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders through effective planning and communication.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
**About Dhaniti™**

Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited is a financial technology company building digital financial infrastructure for individuals, businesses, and institutions.

Our platforms include
**DhanitiPay™**
for UPI-led consumer payments and responsible credit,
**GlocalPe™**
for B2B cross-border payments and financial infrastructure, and institutional solutions spanning cards and education finance.

Dhaniti focuses on building
**secure, scalable, API-driven financial technology products**
with strong emphasis on reliability, compliance, transparency, and customer protection.

**About the Role:**

Dhaniti Fintech is looking for an experienced
**Senior Full Stack Developer**
with strong hands-on experience in frontend and backend development.

You will develop and maintain web applications, backend services, APIs, database solutions, and integrations. You will work with Product, Engineering, DevOps, QA, and Security teams and will be involved in development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The role is suited to a developer who is comfortable taking a feature from
**requirement → development → testing → deployment → production support**
.

**What You Will Do:**

* Develop web applications using
  **React.js and Next.js**
  .
* Develop backend services and APIs using
  **Node.js and NestJS**
  .
* Develop or integrate services using
  **Python and FastAPI**
  , where required.
* Design, develop, and integrate
  **REST APIs**
  and third-party APIs.
* Build reusable frontend components and maintain good frontend performance.
* Design database tables and queries and improve database performance.
* Work with
  **PostgreSQL/MySQL**
  , and where required MongoDB and Redis.
* Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and other application security controls.
* Develop background jobs, asynchronous processes, and integrations where required.
* Fix bugs and resolve application performance, reliability, and production issues.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development and coding standards.
* Write unit, integration, and API tests as appropriate.
* Work with DevOps teams on
  **CI/CD, Docker, deployments, monitoring, and production support**
  .
* Participate in technical and system-design discussions.
* Maintain technical documentation for applications and APIs.
* Work with other developers and help junior developers when required.

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* **5+ years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **React.js and Next.js**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Node.js**
  ; NestJS experience is preferred.
* Strong experience developing and integrating
  **REST APIs**
  .
* Good experience with
  **JavaScript/TypeScript**
  .
* Good experience with
  **SQL and relational databases**
  , preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience developing and supporting
  **production applications**
  .
* Good understanding of Git, debugging, testing, and software development practices.
* Ability to independently handle development tasks from requirements through testing and deployment.
* **Must be based in Hyderabad or within a reasonable commuting distance, with the ability to work on-site.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong experience with
  **NestJS**
  .
* Experience with
  **Python and FastAPI**
  .
* Experience with
  **MongoDB and Redis**
  .
* Experience with
  **Docker and CI/CD pipelines**
  .
* Experience with
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
* Experience with
  **microservices**
  .
* Experience with asynchronous processing, queues, or event-driven applications.
* Experience with
  **Kubernetes**
  .
* Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms.
* Experience with application monitoring, logging, and performance monitoring.
* Experience with
  **OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, MFA, and OWASP Top 10**
  .
* Experience working with
  **fintech, banking, payments, or financial services**
  applications.

**Technical Skills:**

**Frontend:**
React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript

**Backend:**
Node.js, NestJS, Python, FastAPI

**APIs:**
REST APIs, API integrations

**Database:**
PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis

**Development:**
Git, testing, debugging, code reviews

**Cloud & DevOps:**
AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, CI/CD, Kubernetes

**Architecture:**
Microservices, asynchronous processing, event-driven architecture

**Candidate Profile:**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely
  **hands-on with development**
  .
* Has worked on real production applications.
* Can understand requirements and convert them into working software.
* Can work across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
* Can troubleshoot and resolve application issues independently.
* Understands the importance of security, performance, and maintainable code.
* Can work effectively with Product, Engineering, DevOps, QA, and Security teams.
* Is willing to learn new technologies and adapt as the product evolves.

**Why Join Dhaniti™:**

You will work on real-world financial technology products covering
**digital payments, financial services, responsible credit, cross-border payments, and financial infrastructure**
.

The role provides practical exposure across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, cloud, and production systems.

As the technology team grows, there will be opportunities to take on
**greater technical responsibility, specialization, mentoring, and leadership**
, based on capability and contribution.

**What to Expect if Shortlisted:**

* **Initial screening:**
  Discussion with our recruitment team about your experience, technology stack, current role, and logistics.
* **Technical assessment:**
  Practical coding or technical exercise.
* **Technical discussion:**
  Discussion covering your projects, coding approach, APIs, databases, debugging, and system design.
* **Leadership discussion:**
  Conversation with technology/business leadership regarding your experience, ownership, and approach to working in a growing technology environment.
* **Offer & onboarding:**
  For selected candidates.

**How to Apply:**

Please apply with:

* An updated resume showing your
  **actual hands-on development experience**
  , projects, technologies, and individual contribution.
* GitHub, portfolio, or deployed-project links, wherever available.
* Your
  **current notice period and earliest possible joining date**
  .

**Please ensure that the technologies and projects mentioned in your application accurately reflect your actual hands-on experience.**

**Key Technology Stack**

**React.js | Next.js | TypeScript | Node.js | NestJS | Python/FastAPI | REST APIs | PostgreSQL/MySQL | MongoDB | Redis | Docker | CI/CD | AWS/Azure/GCP | Kubernetes**

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**About Dhaniti™**

**Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited**
is a financial technology company building a
**payments-first, credit-enabled digital financial ecosystem**
designed to expand access to formal financial services.

Our flagship consumer platform,
**DhanitiPay™**
, combines UPI-powered digital payments with responsible credit enablement, helping individuals new to formal credit, including students, homemakers, young professionals, and underserved consumers, access financial opportunities.

Complementing DhanitiPay,
**GlocalPe™**
is our B2B cross-border payments and financial infrastructure platform, enabling businesses and ecosystem partners to seamlessly manage international payment flows through technology-driven solutions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for experienced Full Stack Developers to join our technology team and build scalable, secure, production-grade digital financial products.

This is a hands-on engineering role spanning front-end development, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, and application architecture. You will work closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering stakeholders to build applications supporting payments, financial services, and partner integrations.

We are looking for engineers who think beyond writing code, with an understanding of production performance, scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and real-world business requirements.

**What You Will Own**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React.js on the front end and Node.js on the backend.
* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain secure RESTful APIs and, where required, GraphQL APIs, including integrations with third-party services.
* Design and maintain efficient database structures using PostgreSQL/MySQL, with MongoDB exposure as an advantage; optimize queries and indexes for performance.
* Build applications with scalability, performance, security, and reliability in mind, and proactively identify and resolve production issues and bottlenecks.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-structured, and appropriately documented code; participate actively in code reviews and engineering standards.
* Contribute to application architecture, technical design, technology selection, and engineering decisions as the platform evolves.
* Work with cloud environments such as AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and containerized environments such as Docker.
* Collaborate with product, design, QA, and business teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.



**Must-Have Criteria**

* 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in Node.js.
* Strong hands-on experience in React.js and modern JavaScript; TypeScript experience is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs / API development, integration, authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling.
* Strong experience with relational databases and SQL, preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Practical understanding of software design, Git-based development, debugging, testing, code quality, and production application development.
* Ability to own technical problems and work effectively in a fast-evolving product environment.

**Preferred Criteria**

* Fintech / Financial Services domain experience.
* Payment Gateway / UPI Integration exposure.
* Cloud experience with AWS/GCP/Azure.
* Experience with Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.
* Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM APIs, or AI-enabled application development.
* Exposure to transaction-intensive, security-sensitive, or highly available applications.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Building reliable, maintainable, production-ready applications.
* Developing scalable APIs and services that perform reliably under real-world usage.
* Taking ownership of issues from identification through resolution.
* Maintaining high standards of security, performance, testing, and code quality.
* Contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions.
* Collaborating effectively across technology, product, QA, and business teams.

**What to Expect if Shortlisted**

* Initial screening call: A short conversation with our recruitment team to understand your background, current role, technical stack, and logistics.
* Technical assessment: A practical coding exercise or take-home assignment to evaluate hands-on Node.js/React.js development skills.
* Technical panel discussion: A deeper discussion with our engineering team covering past projects, technical decisions, code walkthroughs, system design, and problem-solving approaches.
* Leadership discussion: A conversation with technology and business leadership to understand your overall fit, ownership mindset, and approach to building production-grade products.
* Offer & documentation: For selected candidates, we will share the offer along with the required onboarding documentation.

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You will be a strong fit if you:

* Are genuinely hands-on and comfortable working across the full technology stack.
* Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
* Care about how your code behaves in production, not just whether it works locally.
* Are comfortable working through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* Think about security, performance, scalability, and maintainability while building.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and applying them to real-world problems.

**Why Join Dhaniti™**

At Dhaniti, you will work on technology that sits at the intersection of digital payments, financial services, responsible credit, and financial infrastructure.

You will have the opportunity to work on real-world products, solve meaningful engineering problems, and gain broad exposure across application development, APIs, integrations, cloud, architecture, and emerging technologies.

As the technology organization grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership, deeper specialization, and leadership responsibilities, aligned with your capabilities, contribution, and career aspirations.

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* An updated resume reflecting your actual, hands-on Full Stack Development experience, specific projects, individual contributions, and technologies used.
* A GitHub, portfolio, or deployed-project link, wherever possible, so we can review real work.
* Your current notice period and earliest possible joining date.

Note: We value genuine hands-on experience. Please ensure that the technologies and projects mentioned in your application accurately reflect your individual contribution and practical experience.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer ID86301
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. **WHY JOIN US**
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Tech Lead**
who balances hands-on backend development with team leadership. You will mentor junior developers, uphold strong engineering standards, and help the squad execute with consistency.

* Hands-on experience with Kafka .
* A strong grasp of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOA/OOD) , software design patterns, and architectural pattern awareness.
* Deep understanding and practical experience with strong domain bounded contexts .
* Deep experience building and consuming RESTful services with a clear understanding of standard API protocols.
* Experience working with relational databases ( PostgreSQL, Oracle ) and JPA/Hibernate .
* A passion for server-side logic, performance, and architecture, coupled with good engineering practices.
* Upper-intermediate English level.

**NICE TO HAVES**

* Experience working with spec-driven development or related (AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle).
* Previous experience in the Loyalty or Fintech sectors.

* Experience refactoring legacy structures into modern, domain-driven architectures.

* Remote work & local connection: Work where you feel most productive and connect with your team in periodic meet-ups.
* Legal presence in India: Full local compliance and structured work environment.
* Competitive compensation in INR: Dedicated budgets for growth, education, and wellness.
* Innovative projects: Work with modern technologies and global clients.

title: Software Engineer III, Full Stack, Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with Java software development, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* Experience in front-end web development using client-side JavaScript frameworks (e.g., AngularJS, Angular, or React).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience in developing or consuming Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and connecting User Interface (UI) components to back-end services (e.g., GraphQL or Java).

**About the job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Assisted Development)
description:
**The role, in one line:**
Build production systems that solve whole problems, owned end to end rather than sliced into tickets.

**Why it matters:**
We're a small, senior-led team. What you build ships to real clients in India, the US, and Canada. There's no telephone game between the person who scoped it and the person who codes it.

**What you'll do**

* Own features end to end: frontend, backend, data model, and deployment.
* Turn a messy problem into a clean system with the right schema, workflow, and interface.
* Use AI coding tools to move fast, with the judgment to catch when they're wrong.
* Take full ownership of AI-generated code. Review it, understand it, test it, refactor it, and stand behind it in production as if you wrote every line yourself.
* Harden AI-assisted prototypes into maintainable, secure, production-grade code. That means proper error handling, typing, data validation, access control, and tests.
* Layer AI where it creates real leverage (APIs, MCP, RAG, agents) on top of clean data.
* Work directly with the people whose problem you're solving.

**You'll fit if you have**

* 2–3 years of experience shipping production full-stack applications.
* Strong TypeScript/JavaScript skills: React/Next.js on the frontend, Node/serverless on the backend.
* Comfort owning a relational data model in PostgreSQL. You think in schemas.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, plus informed opinions on where they help and where they fail.
* The discipline to never merge code you can't explain, debug, or maintain.
* Flexibility to work US hours, since that's where most of our clients are.
* Clear communication. You'll work with US clients directly, not through a layer.
* Ownership: you drive the work to done without needing supervision.
* Hunger to learn. The stack moves fast, and so do you.

**Nice to have**

* Supabase / Deno edge functions.
* Experience building AI agents with the Claude API, MCP servers, or RAG pipelines.
* A project you shipped solo that people actually use.

**Why Ninesar**

* Real ownership from day one.
* A senior team, real problems, and work close to the client.
* We care more about the output than the invoice.

Apply via the form link in the first comment 👇

description:

**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
  
  
This role will serve as a hands-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.

Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership

title: AI Native Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
Role Summary
  
  
As a Software Engineer (IC2) at Keyloop, you will be a productive and increasingly independent member of an engineering team building the connected auto retail ecosystem. You will deliver medium-sized features with growing autonomy, write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, and actively contribute to team culture and knowledge sharing. We are tech stack agnostic: we believe a strong engineer with solid fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling can thrive on any technology. This role is ideal for engineers who have moved beyond foundational learning and are ready to take ownership of meaningful deliverables within a collaborative, agile environment.
  
  
**Competency Expectations**
Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains:
  
  
**Competency Domain**
**What We Expect**
**Technical Mastery & Innovation**
Demonstrates proficiency in the team's tech stack. Writes clean, maintainable, well-tested code with minimal guidance. Follows established patterns and contributes to code quality.
  
  
**Execution & Delivery**
Independently owns the delivery of medium-sized features. Accurately estimates tasks and provides reliable status updates. Manages own workload effectively within sprints.
  
  
**Leadership & Influence**
Is a positive influence on team culture. Onboards new team members. Begins to mentor interns or IC1 engineers, helping them ramp up and grow.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Clearly articulates technical concepts to peers. Writes clear and concise documentation. Participates actively in team discussions, code reviews, and design sessions.
  
  
**Product & Business Impact**
Understands the "why" behind their work, including the customer problem and business outcome. Connects technical decisions to user value and product goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software features across the Keyloop platform with increasing independence
* Write clean, well-structured, and thoroughly tested code that meets team coding standards and best practices
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating feedback from peers
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions
* Contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives within an Agile/Scrum framework
* Troubleshoot and resolve defects, contributing to the operational health of the team's systems
* Create and maintain technical documentation for features and components you own
* Onboard new team members and begin mentoring more junior engineers (IC1s, interns)
* Proactively identify and suggest improvements to code quality, tooling, and development processes
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, learning, and adapting to new technologies and codebases

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and object-oriented/functional programming principles
* Proficiency in at least one programming language, with the ability and willingness to learn new languages and frameworks as needed
* Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and practicing test-driven or test-informed development
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding of core software architecture concepts: APIs, services, databases, and modern application design
* Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum development environments
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, debugging, and learning new technologies
* A tech stack agnostic mindset: we value engineers who can adapt to any technology with strong fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling

**Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of professional software development experience

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working across multiple programming languages or tech stacks
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containerization, or modern infrastructure concepts
* Experience with AI-driven development workflows, including prompt engineering for code generation and automated testing
* Experience in the automotive, DMS, or SaaS product domain
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on unfamiliar codebases or technologies using AI-assisted tools

**Soft Skills & Behaviours**

* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English
* A collaborative mindset with a positive attitude toward team culture and knowledge sharing
* Willingness to give and receive constructive feedback openly
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and grow technically
* Ability to manage own workload, estimate tasks accurately, and deliver reliably
* An understanding of the user/customer perspective when making technical decisions

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within the first 3 months, you are shipping features independently and contributing clean, well-tested code with minimal rework
* Within 6 months, you are accurately estimating your own work, reliably delivering within sprint commitments, and onboarding new team members
* Within 12 months, you are a trusted contributor who proactively improves code quality and team processes, and you are beginning to mentor IC1 engineers
* You consistently demonstrate the ability to pick up new technologies and codebases quickly, leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate your learning curve
* Your peers and manager see you as a positive influence on team culture, someone who collaborates openly and gives constructive feedback

**What Sets This Role Apart**

* Tech stack agnostic philosophy: you will not be boxed into a single language or framework. We invest in engineers who master fundamentals and adapt to any technology with AI-assisted tooling
* AI-first engineering culture: you will work within Keyloop's AI-Driven Development Program, using cutting-edge AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, not as an afterthought
* A clear, transparent career framework with defined competency expectations and multi-track progression pathways (Technical, Leadership)
* Real product impact: you will contribute to the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform, connecting every phase of the vehicle lifecycle for dealers and consumers worldwide
* Continuous growth support through a Personal Development Plan (PDP), regular coaching, and access to the AI Champions enablement program
* A global, collaborative engineering community grounded in the values of Bold, Authentic, and United

**Our Guiding Principles**
**We are Bold:**
We challenge the status quo, explore new technologies, and champion high standards for quality.
  
  
**We are Authentic:**
We engage in open, honest, and respectful dialogue. We admit when we are wrong and are transparent about risks.
  
  
**We are United:**
We adopt a platform-first mentality, collaborate seamlessly across teams, and actively mentor others to elevate the entire team.
  
  
**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: Applied AI Platforms Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer II**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Platform Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.

title: AI SOLUTION ENGINEER
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Job title**

Associate AI Solution Engineer

1. JOB Purpose

To design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent chatbots, and AI agent frameworks. The role will focus on building secure, scalable, and business-ready AI applications for internal users and business functions including Research & Development, IT, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance and corporate functions.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge in
**Generative AI**
and should bring experience working in implementing intelligent systems that enable computers to understand, analyze, and reason with both
**visual and textual data**
in a manner similar to human cognition along with basic understanding of pharmaceutical and biotechnology processes, regulatory documentation, SOPs, controlled documents, and compliance-driven environments. The Candidate should have basic knowledge of Software Development.

This position is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

1. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

**AI Chatbot, RAG & Agent Development**

* Develop research and product roadmaps aligning with scientific and business objectives.
* Develop AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants for internal business users.
* Build RAG-based applications that retrieve answers from SharePoint, PDFs, Word documents, SOPs, policies, databases, and internal knowledge repositories.
* Create AI agent workflows for knowledge retrieval, document review, authoring, and business process automation.
* Use frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Llama Index, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools under technical guidance.
* Apply prompt engineering, grounding techniques, response validation, and evaluation methods to improve answer quality and reduce hallucinations.

**Data & Knowledge Integration**

* Support document ingestion pipelines for PDFs, Word files, Excel files, SOPs, regulatory content, and knowledge articles.
* Work on chunking, metadata extraction, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, and citation-based response generation.
* Use vector databases/search tools such as Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB

**Application Development & Deployment**

* Develop backend APIs and AI services using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Develop document processing solutions using OCR, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and intelligent data extraction technique
* Support deployment and maintenance of AI applications using Azure services, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Security, Governance & Documentation**

* Follow organizational security, privacy, access control, and data governance standards while developing AI solutions.
* Support responsible AI practices including auditability, monitoring, explainability, and controlled use of enterprise data.
* Prepare technical documentation, user guides, architecture notes, test cases, and validation-support documents where required.

3. QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's or master's degrees in engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Machine Learning, or a related engineering discipline.
* 2-5 years of experience in AI engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or application development.
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on exposure to Generative AI, chatbot development, RAG solutions, LLM APIs, or AI agent-based applications.
* Strong programming knowledge in Python, Java Scripts and basic understanding of APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and deployment practices.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Must Have

Python, REST APIs, SQL basics, GitHub, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, document processing

AI / GenAI

Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, response evaluation

Frameworks

Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Semantic Kernel, React,Node.js

Cloud

Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure App Services

Vector DB/Search

Azure AI Search

Application Dev

HTML/CSS, JavaScript basics, API integration

DevOps

Docker basics, CI/CD basics, deployment and monitoring awareness

BASIC PHARMA & BIOTECH KNOWLEDGE

* The candidate should have basic awareness of pharma and biotech work environments so that AI solutions can be aligned with business needs, document control expectations, and compliance requirements.
* Basic understanding of drug discovery, drug development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality assurance, and manufacturing processes.
* Awareness of SOPs, protocols, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, CTD modules, policies, and controlled documents.
* Basic knowledge of GxP concepts, data integrity, audit trails, version control, document lifecycle management, and approval of workflows.
* Familiarity with regulatory references such as FDA, EMA, ICH guidelines, and 21 CFR Part 11 is preferred.
* Understanding AI uses cases in pharma/biotech such as regulatory document search, medical writing assistance, clinical knowledge assistant, pharmacovigilance triage, quality document review, and R&D knowledge management.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure AI Fundamentals.
* Certification or practical training in Generative AI, LLM application development, machine learning, or cloud AI services.

KEY COMPETENCIES

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to convert business requirements into AI-enabled solutions.
* Good communication skills for working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Awareness of enterprise security, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
* Learning mindset with the ability to adapt to fast-changing AI technologies.

SUCCESS MEASURES

* Delivery of working AI chatbots, RAG applications, and AI agents for business use cases.
* Improved knowledge retrieval and reduced manual search effort for users.
* Accurate, grounded, and citation-supported AI responses.
* Compliance with security, privacy, and data governance requirements.
* Positive adoption and feedback from business stakeholders.

4. PHYSICAL REQUIRMENT

This is a largelysedentary role.

* This position is
  **fully office‑based (on‑site)**
  .
* Job may require availability beyond standard working hours to support priority business needs, audits, or inspections.

5. DIRECT REPORT
