 Steps AI is a product company building intelligent, AI\-powered software for modern businesses. We design and ship production systems that combine strong user experience, reliable backends, and data\-driven intelligence. We work with real customers, deploy to both cloud and on\-premises environments, and move from prototype to production with a high bar for security, access control, and operational quality.
 




  






 We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end \- interface, API, data, security, and deployment \- rather than a single layer of the stack.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We are hiring a Full\-Stack SDE who can take a working product, demo, or prototype and turn it into a reliable, role\-based, securely deployed application that real users can operate on. You will work across the frontend, backend APIs, database, and deployment — and you will be expected to raise the quality of design, access control, and operations as you go, not just add screens.
 




  






 This is an individual\-contributor role with real ownership. You will implement features from specification to production, participate in reviews, and support releases to cloud and on\-premises environments.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**Frontend** 



* Build production web applications in React and TypeScript (Next.js experience is a strong plus) with a clear, consistent UI.
* Implement dashboards, tables, filters, forms, maps or geographic views, and multi\-step workflows that stay usable under real data volumes.
* Translate product requirements and design intent into responsive, accessible interfaces. You will make design decisions when a finished mock is not available.
* Integrate the UI with backend APIs using disciplined client state, caching, error states, and loading behaviour.



  





**Backend and APIs** 



* Design and implement REST APIs (Python/FastAPI or Node/TypeScript) with clear contracts, validation, and error handling.
* Implement authentication and session handling (JWT, OAuth, or server sessions) and enforce authorization on every sensitive path.
* Build workflow, notification, file, and reporting endpoints that are safe to expose in a multi\-user system.
* Write services that are observable: structured logs, meaningful status codes, and failure modes that operators can diagnose.



  





**Database and Data** 



* Model relational data (PostgreSQL or equivalent), write migrations, and keep schemas versioned and reviewable.
* Index, query, and paginate so list and analytics views stay fast as data grows.
* Handle imports, exports, and data\-quality checks without corrupting the system of record.
* Participate in backup, restore, and environment\-promotion practices for the data layer.



  





**Security, RBAC, and Hardening** 



* Implement role\-based access control so users only see and change what their role and scope allow.
* Harden applications that began as demos: remove unsafe defaults, lock down admin paths, add audit trails, and treat secrets correctly.
* Apply basic application security: input validation, CSRF/CORS discipline, password hashing, session expiry, least privilege.
* Support secure configuration for on\-premises installs (environment separation, TLS, controlled admin access).



  





**Deployment and Operations** 



* Package and deploy the full application (web \+ API \+ database) using Docker and a documented release path.
* Contribute to CI/CD, environment promotion (dev / staging / production), and rollback discipline.
* Debug production issues across the stack instead of stopping at the layer you last touched.
* Travel when needed to client or on\-premises sites in Hyderabad to install, verify, or support a release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–4 years of professional software engineering with production systems in use by real users.
* Proven ability to ship a feature across UI, API, and database — not only one of the three.
* Strong TypeScript or modern JavaScript, and solid Python or Node on the server.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, migrations, and query basics.
* Practical experience with Git, code review, and collaborative branching.
* Comfort with Docker\-based local development and at least one CI/CD system.
* Clear written communication: you can turn a product note into a technical plan without many clarification rounds.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on\-premises locations as required.
* Next.js (App Router), TanStack Query, and a modern component system (for example shadcn/ui).
* FastAPI or NestJS in production.
* Experience adding RBAC, audit logs, or approval workflows to an existing application.
* Maps, charts, or other data\-heavy interfaces.
* AI\-assisted product features (assistants, retrieval, streaming UIs) as a consumer of APIs.
* On\-premises or restricted\-network deployment experience.
* Basic automated tests (unit, API, or Playwright/Cypress).



  





**Location, Work Mode, and Travel** 





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team.
 





 Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short\-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role.
 




  





**What We Offer** 



* High\-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted products, enterprise\-grade access control, and real production deployments.
* Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone.
* Learning budget for courses and certifications.
* Collaborative in\-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**AI Security Incubation \& Innovation**
**Security and Risk Engineering**
****About The Team****
 The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI\-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI\-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.
   

  

 This is a zero\-to\-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer – AI Native Development, you will design, build, and operate next\-generation AI\-powered applications and platforms. You will combine strong full\-stack software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on expertise in modern AI/ML technologies to build production\-grade experiences powered by LLMs, agents, retrieval, and intelligent automation.
   

  

 You will work across the technology stack—from user experiences and APIs to distributed services, data and retrieval systems, AI/ML workflows, and cloud infrastructure. You will be expected to use AI\-native development practices to accelerate engineering productivity while maintaining high standards for scalability, reliability, security, and quality.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems end\-to\-end and is excited about applying AI as a core engineering capability, not simply as an add\-on to traditional software.
   

  

****What You'll Own****
* Design and build end\-to\-end full\-stack applications, including frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, data layers, and cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Build production\-grade AI/ML\-powered capabilities using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, agentic workflows, and intelligent decision\-making.
* Design and implement agentic architectures, including tool calling, orchestration, planning loops, memory, context management, and failure recovery.
* Develop reliable AI\-powered APIs and services that integrate frontier models and enterprise data securely and efficiently.
* Build retrieval and grounding pipelines using vector search, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and contextual enrichment.
* Establish evaluation and observability mechanisms to measure AI quality, accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and safety.
* Take features from concept and prototype through production deployment and ongoing operation, with ownership of quality and reliability.
* Work with product, design, platform, data, security, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Contribute to architecture and design decisions, code reviews, engineering standards, and technical direction.
* Mentor engineers and help raise the bar on full\-stack engineering and production AI development practices.


****What You'll Do****
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable frontend applications and backend services using REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and distributed systems.
* Work with modern frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or equivalent frameworks.
* Build cloud\-native applications with strong focus on scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Own software delivery across development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production operations.
* Build applications leveraging LLMs, generative AI, embeddings, RAG, semantic search, and agentic workflows.
* Integrate frontier AI models and SDKs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent platforms.
* Apply prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context engineering, and model selection to real\-world applications.
* Design agent workflows that can reason, use tools, retrieve information, execute actions, and recover from failures.
* Build AI evaluation frameworks and automated tests to measure model and application quality.
* Balance model capability, accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost when selecting and integrating AI models.
* Apply AI safety, security, privacy, governance, and guardrail practices to production AI systems.
* Explore and adopt emerging AI technologies and rapidly turn promising capabilities into production\-ready solutions.


**AI\-Native Engineering Practices**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent tools as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Apply AI to improve engineering productivity across coding, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and system design.
* Develop effective workflows for collaborating with coding agents while maintaining engineering quality and accountability.
* Help establish best practices for AI\-native software development across the engineering organization.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production\-quality software.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience developing full\-stack applications, with strength in both frontend and backend engineering.
* Strong programming experience in one or more of Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages.
* Experience with modern frontend development, preferably React and TypeScript or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications, scalable APIs, microservices, databases, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience building or integrating AI/ML\-powered applications in production or near\-production environments.
* Practical understanding of modern AI concepts including LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector databases/search, semantic search, agents, tool calling, and model evaluation.
* Experience integrating one or more frontier AI model platforms/SDKs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.
* Ability to take an AI/ML prototype and turn it into a reliable, scalable, maintainable production solution.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and system\-design skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, design, data, and platform teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and a track record of improving code quality and engineering practices.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience designing multi\-agent systems and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with vector databases, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, knowledge graphs, or enterprise search.
* Experience with ML pipelines, MLOps, model monitoring, or inference optimization.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML or developer tooling projects.
* Experience working on cybersecurity, identity, risk, enterprise SaaS, or other complex domain platforms is a plus.


****Qualifications****

* Experience designing and delivering production software systems.
* Experience building or integrating AI/ML\-powered applications in a production or near\-production environment.
* Modern AI experience: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability.
* Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Cybersecurity or security\-product experience is a plus.


****What Success Looks Like****
 In this role, you will be successful when you can:
   

  

* Build end\-to\-end: Take a product requirement from UI and API design through AI services, data, deployment, and production operation.
* Build AI\-native: Understand when and how to apply LLMs, agents, retrieval, and other AI capabilities to solve problems effectively.

title: Software Development Engineer, PXT Case Management System
description:
**Description**
 Do you want to revolutionize how millions of Amazonians worldwide receive HR support? Are you passionate about building intelligent, AI\-powered solutions that transform employee experiences? Do you want to work on a platform that combines AWS services with generative AI to deliver personalized, efficient HR support at Amazon scale? If so, we invite you to join the PXT Case Management team within HR Experience and Technologies org.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will collaborate with senior engineers (SDE\-IIIs and L5s) to implement components of our 3\-year architecture plans while gaining deeper understanding of system design and architectural patterns. You'll be responsible for driving individual projects from design to delivery, making data\-driven decisions to balance technical debt with business needs. You will have opportunities to mentor SDE\-I engineers on coding practices and technical implementation while receiving mentorship from senior team members to grow your technical and leadership skills. You'll work closely with SDMs and PMs to break down complex requirements into executable tasks and contribute to technical discussions that shape team\-level solutions. Additionally, you'll be expected to demonstrate ownership of your work by maintaining high standards for code quality, participating in on\-call rotations, and continuously improving our operational excellence.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

* Write maintainable, well\-structured, and testable code to advance your in\-flight project and submit a code review to the team
* Design a system to solve an Amazon scale problem and present a design document to the team to build consensus on your recommended approach
* Attend a team\-level operations review meeting to understand system health and identify actions we need to take to keep the system available for our clients
* Meet with a customer to understand the problems they are facing, brainstorm solutions, and discuss with your management to affect team priorities
* Review a teammate's code change and raise the bar on team code quality by providing insightful comments
* Research new technologies that could help simplify your team's system and draft a message to the team with your findings
* Root cause and resolve a trouble ticket filed by a customer of your system
* Attend a one to one meeting with your manager to receive support on your work and discuss career development

title: Software Development Engineer 2
description:
**About the Role** 




 LivSYT is building an AI\-native engineering platform that automates complex infrastructure design \- from engineering calculations and 3D/CAD models to drawings and downstream project workflows.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the platform layer connecting our CAD/geometry engine, AI systems and cloud infrastructure.
 **This is not a conventional CRUD/API development role.** 
 You will work on large engineering models, distributed computation, real\-time collaboration, versioning, multi\-user concurrency and secure enterprise deployments. You will have significant ownership over architecture and technical decisions as the platform scales globally.
 



  
 



**What You Will Own** 



* Design and build high\-performance backend services using Python, FastAPI and asynchronous programming.
* Architect APIs and distributed services connecting CAD/geometry engines, AI agents and cloud services.
* Build systems for processing and managing large engineering/CAD models and binary files, including DWG, IFC and BREP workflows.
* Design real\-time multi\-user collaboration: concurrency, versioning, locking, conflict resolution and recovery.
* Build event\-driven and asynchronous workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or equivalent systems.
* Design scalable data architectures using PostgreSQL, Redis and object storage such as S3\.
* Own performance, observability, reliability and production troubleshooting for cloud\-native services on AWS.
* Design secure multi\-tenant architecture including RBAC/ABAC, auditability, encryption and enterprise data isolation.
* Build and improve CI/CD for backend services using Git, Docker and modern deployment pipelines.
* Work directly with CAD, AI, frontend and product engineers to take systems from architecture through production.



  
 



**What We Are Looking For** 




**Must have** 



* 5\+ years building production backend or platform systems.
* Excellent Python fundamentals and production experience with FastAPI, Django, Flask or another modern Python backend framework.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, distributed systems and service\-oriented architecture.
* Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals: schema design, transactions, indexing and query optimization.
* Experience with event/message systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
* Production experience with AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker and CI/CD.
* Strong system\-design ability and experience diagnosing performance, scalability and reliability problems in production.
* Evidence of owning systems end\-to\-end \- not only implementing tickets.



**Strong advantage** 



* Experience with large\-file or binary\-data processing.
* WebSockets, collaborative editing, distributed locking, version\-control or other real\-time systems.
* Kubernetes, ECS or EKS and production observability tooling.
* CAD, GIS, gaming engines, simulation, geometry or 3D systems.
* AI/LLM infrastructure, agent integration or model\-serving workflows.
* Enterprise multi\-tenant SaaS, permissions, security and audit systems.



**The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here** 



* You enjoy hard systems problems and can move between architecture, code, debugging and production.
* You make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed, scalability and engineering quality.
* You can challenge an architecture constructively and then take ownership of the solution.
* You are comfortable working closely with domain engineers, product leaders and other senior engineers.
* You want to build core technology rather than maintain a mature legacy platform.



**Why LivSYT** 



* Work at the intersection of CAD, AI and distributed cloud systems.
* Build software that helps automate how major physical infrastructure is designed and delivered.
* Own meaningful parts of the core platform while the architecture is still being built.
* Work directly with senior engineering and product leadership with substantial technical autonomy.
* See your systems used on real\-world transportation and data\-center engineering workflows.



  
 



**Technology Environment** 




**Python / FastAPI \| PostgreSQL / Redis \| Kafka / async workers \| AWS / S3 / RDS / ECS \| Docker / CI/CD \| CAD \& geometry services \| AI services** 




  
 



**Location** 




**Hyderabad \- Work from Office** 
 . This is a hands\-on product engineering role with close collaboration across the CAD, AI, backend, frontend and product teams.
 



  
 



**About LivSYT** 




 LivSYT builds AI\-powered software for the engineering and construction ecosystem. Our platform connects engineering design, digital workflows, project controls and automation to help infrastructure and data\-center teams move from fragmented, memory\-dependent processes toward software\-driven engineering and execution.
 



  
 



*LivSYT is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Role: Regulatory AI \& Automation Specialist
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Job Type: Full Time
   

  

 Years of Experience: 4–6 years
   

  

 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
   

  

 That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 Mission
   

  

 Roche Services \& Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever\-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end\-to\-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient\-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai \& Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer\-centric 24/7 and co\-create solutions together.
   

  

 The PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter is accountable for creating and maintaining a framework for building, maturing, and sustaining PDR business capabilities. This includes fostering innovation, ensuring operational readiness, and implementing continuous improvement across our regulatory processes, systems, and tools. Chapter members lead by designing and deploying innovative, compliant solutions that optimize regulatory workflows while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and data quality. We operate with enterprise thinking in a highly transformative regulated environment—assessing end\-to\-end processes, anticipating regulatory landscape changes, and unlocking company\-wide benefits through strategic partnerships across PD, affiliates, Pharma, and the Roche group. Success in this chapter requires strategic thinking, systems thinking, data and content management expertise, an enterprise mindset, and the ability to drive continuous improvement and change leadership in a matrix environment.
   

  

 Your Opportunity
   

  

 As a Regulatory AI \& Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands\-on digital execution of regulatory operations. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy AI\-driven tools, document intelligence engines, and automated workflows that accelerate regulatory document processing, submission dossier management, and compliance tracking across global health authorities
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high\-value use cases for regulatory document workflows
* Build and deploy scalable AI, machine learning, and automation solutions—integrating RPA, Low\-Code/No\-Code platforms, Python, NLP, and cloud\-native services like AWS—specifically tailored to optimize global regulatory workflows and document management.
* Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation \& Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high\-impact AI and automation opportunities
* Support IT team by providing business directions for ongoing technical \& preventive maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting for all deployed automation scripts, machine learning models, and AI assets operating in production
* Maintain comprehensive technical artifacts (including solution architecture, source code repositories, and testing frameworks) and conduct hands\-on internal training to empower business teams and drive adoption across global regulatory functions
* Drive cross\-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation \& Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
* Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders
* Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency


 Who You Are
   

  

 You are a hands\-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R\&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem\-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production\-ready AI tools.
   

  

 Qualifications \& Technical Skillset:
   

  

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands\-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
* Education \& Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R\&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
* Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi\-agent orchestration
* Core Programming \& Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production\-ready code
* Document AI \& Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word)
* AI \& LLM Integration: Hands\-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying
* Software Engineering \& APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices
* Workflow \& Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low\-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers
* Exposure to Deployment \& Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services


 Strong to have:
   

  

* Prompt Architecture \& Validation: Ability to design complex, multi\-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively
* Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance


 Note: This job description is intended as a general guideline for the responsibilities and qualifications required for this position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve and change based on business needs.
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**

* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.


 Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.

* Strong troubleshooting and incident\-management skills

* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.

description:

 If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sub Value Stream Tech Lead.**
**The Opportunity**
 Group Functions Technology is a Global Function encompassing platforms that are vital to the bank’s operation. Our mission is to “ Enable, Protect and Delight ” HSBC’s global businesses.
   

  

 Within Group Functions Technology, Risk and Compliance Technology is building a real\-time decisioning capability that can evaluate transaction events, coordinate multiple detection techniques and select the right preventative action within strict sub\-second latency budgets. Sitting above HSBC's real\-time data feeds, the platform will orchestrate rules, machine\-learning models, graph capabilities, foundation models and approved bounded agent functions across real\-time, near\-real\-time and asynchronous execution tiers.

* Define and build HSBC’s real\-time decisioning and model\-orchestration platform for financial crime prevention
* Translate financial\-crime policy and customer\-outcome requirements into deterministic, explainable and auditable technical decisions
* Architect a resilient runtime that selects execution capabilities, sequences and parallelism and calibrates outputs into a traceable decision
* Engineer low\-latency, highly available distributed systems with explicit time budgets, fallbacks, circuit breakers and safe degradation

* Emphasize Java and Python, event\-driven architecture, Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes and cloud\-native engineering.

 :

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data \& AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As part of the Data Platform team at ThoughtSpot, you'll build and evolve the core platform powering secure, reliable, and high\-performance connectivity between ThoughtSpot and modern cloud data warehouses. The team owns query execution, connection management, authentication, JDBC integrations, platform observability, semantic services, and AI\-powered platform capabilities.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and develop scalable backend platform services using Java 17/21\+.
* Own query execution, connection lifecycle, authentication, JDBC driver management, and CDW metrics.
* Build integrations with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse and other cloud warehouses.
* Improve reliability, scalability, performance, and observability.
* Develop semantic metadata services and AI\-assisted platform capabilities.
* Leverage LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and MCP integrations to enhance platform intelligence.
* Collaborate with Product, AI, Security, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams.
* Drive engineering excellence through testing, automation, and operational ownership


**What You Bring**
* 4\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong Java (17/21\+), distributed systems, and backend architecture.
* Deep understanding of SQL, query execution, JDBC, connection pooling, and database internals.
* Experience with OAuth, SAML, OIDC, JWT, Kerberos, or similar authentication technologies.
* Hands\-on AWS/cloud\-native development experience.
* Knowledge of observability (metrics, logging, tracing).
* Exposure to semantic layers, metadata management, LLMs, Agentic AI (LangChain/LangGraph/LlamaIndex), RAG, and vector databases.
* Excellent ownership, debugging, and communication skills.


****In\-Office at ThoughtSpot****
 Spotters are expected to be in office 3\+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem\-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in\-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
   

  

**About ThoughtSpot**
 The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI\-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C\-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
   

  

 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
   

  

**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
 Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
   

  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.


 Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
   

  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary


 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
   

  

****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
 At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
   

  

 All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
   

  

****ThoughtSpot for All****
 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
 ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives \- this balance\-for\-the\-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and platform engineering.
   

  

  Passion for building developer platforms and AI\-native analytics infrastructure.

Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 



  





**Job Title: AI / Automation SME** 




**Location: India** 




**About the Role:** 




 As an AI / Automation SME, you’ll be at the core of Zurich’s “AI First” delivery — building, testing, and optimizing production\-grade Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI solutions. You will develop GenAI and agentic capabilities (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering) that accelerate development, automate manual effort, and improve troubleshooting — delivering reliable, secure, observable, responsible, and compliant solutions that drive data\-driven decisions and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop, configure, and maintain production\-grade AI / Generative AI solutions (LLM applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows) across the global organization (Group and BU levels).
* Build RAG and retrieval pipelines with attention to retrieval quality (chunking, embeddings, reranking) and measure it, not just assemble it.
* Choose the simplest solution that meets the need — knowing when a single well\-designed agent or pipeline beats a complex multi\-agent system.
* Perform prompt engineering, testing, evaluation, troubleshooting, and optimization of AI solutions for accuracy, latency, and cost; build eval sets and catch hallucinations.
* Instrument solutions with observability/tracing (e.g., Langfuse / OpenTelemetry) and apply basic AI security practices: prompt\-injection awareness, safe tool use, secrets and PII handling.
* Work closely with the Lead AI / Automation SME, architects, business analysts, and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical deliverables.
* Implement integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems like Databricks, leveraging APIs and appropriate middleware.
* Building, operating, and continuously improving the systems in scope while leveraging AI capabilities to accelerate development, improve troubleshooting / enhance governance outcomes.
* Reduce manual remediation effort by identifying recurring patterns and optimization opportunities in the scope using AI\-supported insights.
* Contribute to the service’s AI adoption goals and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Document solution designs, model/agent logic, and workflows clearly and comprehensively; use ADO, JIRA and SNOW to manage work and enable smooth releases.
* Ensure all solutions comply with Zurich’s quality, security, data privacy, and responsible\-AI standards.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 4–8 years building software / AI solutions, including 2\+ years hands\-on with Generative AI in production (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering); agentic experience a strong plus.
* Proven track record of integrating solutions with enterprise applications/platforms (like Databricks) via ADO and APIs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and a focus on evaluation and impact analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in supporting operational activities and continuous improvement.
* Collaborative mindset and effective communicator, fluent in English.



  





**Must have Skills (Top 5 skills):** 



* **Hands\-on Generative AI development at production quality (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, agent frameworks such as LangChain / LangGraph / CrewAI or similar).**
* **Python and solid software engineering / testing fundamentals (including testing non\-deterministic AI outputs).**
* **AI evaluation \& observability: eval sets, tracing (e.g., Langfuse / OpenTelemetry), and cost/latency/hallucination awareness.**
* **Basic AI security \& responsible AI: prompt\-injection awareness, safe tool use, secrets/PII handling.**
* **Strong “AI First” mindset with AI tools/frameworks knowledge; Azure DevOps (ADO) for development and releases.**



  





**Nice to have Skills:** 



* Robotic Process Automation (RPA) exposure (e.g., UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate) — optional / complementary.
* Cloud (Azure / AWS), Databricks, vector databases, Data Science / ML basics.
* JIRA and SNOW for delivery and service management.

**What’s in it for you:**

title: Engineer II, Software (RPA)
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 Ensemble Health Partners is one of the fastest\-growing revenue cycle management companies in healthcare. Our Automation \& AI Platform team is building the next generation of intelligent automation: moving beyond traditional rule\-based bots into agentic, AI\-driven automation and Computer Use Agents (CUA) that can see, reason about, and operate real applications the way a person does. We are looking for an Engineer II who lives and breathes Python and wants to build production automation at the intersection of RPA and applied AI. You will design and ship automations across web, Citrix, and document\-heavy workflows, then push them further with LLMs, OCR, and agentic techniques so they handle the messy, unstructured cases that classic RPA cannot. We care about how you reason about brittle real\-world systems, write clean Python, and learn quickly. Our stack spans Python, Playwright, Azure, Docker, and a fast\-growing agentic / CUA layer built on Azure OpenAI and open\-source LLMs. Strong engineers pick up the parts they haven't seen fast.
 



**Role \& responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test, and maintain production automations in Python across web, Citrix, and API\-driven workflows.
* Automate applications end to end: web automation (Playwright or Selenium), Citrix and virtual\-desktop automation, and OCR or document\-based automation.
* Build agentic and Computer Use Agent (CUA) automations that combine LLMs with UI control to handle tasks that rule\-based bots cannot.
* Apply document processing and intelligent data extraction, blending OCR with LLMs to turn unstructured inputs into structured, usable data.
* Integrate REST and SOAP APIs (auth, pagination, retries, error handling), preferring API\-driven steps over fragile UI wherever an API exists.
* Handle unattended\-execution concerns: secure secret handling, MFA such as TOTP, scheduling, structured logging, and graceful recovery.
* Package automations as Docker containers, run them on Azure, and ship through Azure DevOps Git with PR review and CI/CD pipelines.

 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. * Use Claude Code as a daily working tool: agentic and prompt\-driven development, refactoring, test generation, codebase exploration and documentation.

* Critically review AI\-generated code for correctness, security, licensing and maintainability — you stay accountable for everything you merge.
* Share patterns and prompt techniques that work, and help raise the team's AI engineering maturity.



  





**Quality, security and operations:** 



* Write automated tests at the right level (unit, integration, contract, end\-to\-end) and treat coverage as a design tool, not a target.
* Apply secure\-by\-design principles: threat awareness, input validation, authentication and authorisation, secrets handling, dependency hygiene.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability, alerting and incident response for the services your team owns.
* Keep technical debt visible and manageable, and improve performance, reliability and cost efficiency.



  





**Collaborate and improve:** 



* Work closely with product owners, designers, architects, security and other engineering teams to shape solutions and trade\-offs.
* Review peers' code constructively, pair or mob when it helps, and mentor less experienced colleagues.
* Document decisions clearly, including architecture decision records and solution documentation aligned to our architecture documentation standard.
* Take part in refinement, planning, retrospectives and communities of practice, and bring ideas for how we can work better.



  





**Technical skills we're looking for:** 



* **Frontend** 
 \- Strong React (function components, hooks, composition patterns, state management such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand or TanStack Query), TypeScript, modern build tooling (Vite or similar), component\-driven development with Storybook, forms and validation, routing, and meta\-frameworks such as Next.js as a plus.

 \- Confident in at least one modern backend stack — Php (Laravel Octane), Node.js (NestJS, Express, Fastify), Python (FastAPI, Django) — with clean layering, dependency injection and domain modelling.
* **APIs and integration** 
 \-
 
 API\-first design with REST and OpenAPI; versioning, pagination, idempotency, error contracts, rate limiting and resilience patterns (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers); event\-driven integration (Kafka, Service Bus, queues) a strong plus.
* **Data** 
 \- Relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) including schema design, indexing, query tuning and migrations; NoSQL and caching (MongoDB, Redis, Cosmos DB) where it fits; ORM use and its limits.
* **Security**

description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we're saying, keep reading!
   

  

 WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
   

  

 As a Product Engineer with 10 years of experience, you sit at the intersection of product thinking and engineering execution. You own the full arc of a feature — from understanding the problem, to building a working prototype, shipping and delivering its outcome. You bring both the business knowledge of what to build and the technical depth to ensure it is built well, with a personal stake in quality at every stage
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 Product Value Delivery
   

  

* Translate business goals and user needs into product opportunities with clear value hypotheses.
* Prototype solutions early and often — directly, to validate ideas before committing to full build
* Define scope collaboratively with stakeholders, keeping scope anchored to user value rather than feature count.
* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.


**What We Are Looking For**
 An experienced Product Engineer doesn’t wait for a spec to be handed to them — they shape it. They prototype before they present, validate before build, and measure after ship. They push back on scope that doesn't serve users, and they focus on quality that does. They make the team faster by removing ambiguity, not by adding process.
   

  

**Skills Experience**
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in development and testing disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to move from problem statement to working prototype quickly.
* Experience writing precise technical requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on quality assurance: test design, validation, and defect triage.
* Experience working directly with clients or external counterparties.
* Solid grounding in financial instruments — Repos, Derivatives, or related collateral/securities product
* Comfortable running demos, gathering requirements from business users, and translating business workflows into system behaviour.
* Ability to frame engineering decisions in terms of user and business value.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and structuring problems before solving them.
* Strong stakeholder communication — able to translate freely between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) in a professional context.
* Demonstrated critical evaluation of AI\-generated outputs — not just accepting but interrogating them.
* Understanding of AI limitations relevant to software delivery: hallucination, context loss, security blind spots.
* Agile practitioner: fluent in Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong documentation habits; treats the knowledge base as part of the product.
* Collaborative by default, decisive when needed.


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self\-Direction — High degree of self\-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.


 NEXT STEPS
   

  

 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready
   

  

 to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
   

  

 We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

description:
**Role Overview**  

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.


The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.

**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected**

**About Role**

**1\. End\-to\-End BI Solution Development**

* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.

**2\. Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL**

* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.

**3\. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization**

* Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterized views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

**4\. Data Analysis and Insights**

* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.

**5\. Data Governance, Documentation, and Support**

* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**6\. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.

**About You**

* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* *Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)*
* *Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse*
* *Power BI datasets, reports, and apps*
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

**Analytical and Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.

**Education/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are building a lean, high\-velocity engineering team to develop productized agentic AI applications on top of Savanna. Our flagship application focuses on agentic fraud investigation, with a broader mission to build a reusable suite of enterprise AI products that can be rapidly configured and deployed across customers.
 



 We are seeking a
 **Senior Full\-Stack Product Engineer** 
 with strong skills in
 **Java or Python** 
 on the backend and
 **Angular or React** 
 on the frontend. Working alongside an AI Engineer focused on LLMs, GraphRAG, and agent orchestration, you will own the full application stack—turning core AI capabilities into secure, scalable, and intuitive enterprise products from concept to production.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Full\-Stack Application Engineering** 



* Architect, build, and maintain production\-grade full\-stack applications using
 **Java or Python** 
 microservices/REST APIs and modern
 **Angular or React** 
 web interfaces.
* Design robust backend systems that handle asynchronous, long\-running agent workflows, state management, event\-driven data pipelines, and third\-party enterprise integrations.
* Build intuitive, dynamic frontend interfaces to visualize complex agent reasoning, graph networks, and interactive human\-in\-the\-loop workflows (approval mechanisms, override controls, and audit trails).
* Develop modular, configurable architectures separating reusable application code from tenant\-specific configurations.



**2\. Enterprise Security, Governance \& Agent Controls** 



* Implement enterprise\-grade security models, including Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi\-tenancy, and secure API gateways.
* Design backend safeguards and transactional boundaries to prevent unauthorized or runaway agent executions.
* Build complete auditability logging to trace user requests, AI tool executions, state changes, and system errors.



**3\. Deployment, Scalability \& Cloud Packaging** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery using modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud hosting across
 **AWS and Google Cloud** 
 .
* Prepare, package, and optimize applications for commercial distribution via
